# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
  cat('FILE',f,'\\n')
  x <- readRDS(f)
  at <- attributes(x)
  cat('attrs:', paste(names(at),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  for (nm in names(at)) cat(nm, 'typeof=',typeof(at[[nm]]), 'length=',length(at[[nm]]),'class=',paste(attr(at[[nm]],'class'),collapse='/'),'\\n')
  rn <- attr(x,'rownames')
  i <- match('PA14_35160',rn)
  cat('target index',i,'\\n')
  ld <- attr(x,'listData')
  cat('listData names:',paste(names(ld),collapse=', '),' length',length(ld),'\\n')
  for (nm in names(ld)) cat(nm, format(ld[[nm]][i],digits=17), '\\n')
  md <- attr(x,'metadata')
  cat('metadata typeof',typeof(md),'names',paste(names(md),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  if(length(md)) dput(md)
  em <- attr(x,'elementMetadata')
  cat('elementMetadata attrs',paste(names(attributes(em)),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  eld <- attr(em,'listData')
  cat('element metadata listData names:',paste(names(eld),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  for(nm in names(eld)) { cat('emd',nm,':'); dput(eld[[nm]]) }
}
RS"

for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
  cat('FILE',f,'\\n')
  x <- readRDS(f)

  ld <- attr(x,'listData',exact=TRUE)
  cat('target index',i,'\\n')

  for (j in seq_along(ld)) cat(names(ld)[j], format(ld[[j]][i],digits=17), '\\n')
  md <- attr(x,'metadata',exact=TRUE)
  cat('metadata names',paste(names(md),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  if(is.list(md)) dput(md)
  em <- attr(x,'elementMetadata',exact=TRUE)
  eld <- attr(em,'listData',exact=TRUE)
  cat('element metadata listData names:',paste(names(eld),collapse=', '),'\\n')
  for(j in seq_along(eld)) { cat('emd',names(eld)[j],':'); dput(eld[[j]]) }
}
